documents.text: Time for Love (film) Time for Love is a Fleischer Studios film directed by Dave Fleischer and distributed by Paramount Pictures. It was released in September 6, 1935. The cartoon focuses on a mute swan couple who love each other, A greedy and stubborn black swan attracts the female who decides to go with him, rather than the male mute swan leaving him depressed.
